rows.title: Spurt in Volume
rows.summary: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Kopran Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Kopran Limited has submitted their response.
